summary: Tested premium monetization features: 10 Breathlove sessions, payment checkout APIs, entitlements, Rose Temple/Healing Portals lock states, and Pricing page toggle. Backend: 19/20 tests passed. Frontend: All premium lock UI elements working correctly. Fixed minor double-dollar-sign UI bug in Rose Temple and Healing Portals pages.

minor.issue: Returns 200 for unauthenticated users (returns empty/default entitlements). This is acceptable behavior but test expected 401/403.

VERIFIED: All Breathlove sessions have is_premium=true, premium_unlock_id=premium_breathwork, premium_label=Breathlove
VERIFIED: POST /api/payments/create-checkout works for all 4 premium_unlock product_ids (premium_breathwork, rose_temple, healing_portals, full_app_unlock)
VERIFIED: GET /api/payments/entitlements returns sections map with premium_breathwork, rose_temple, healing_portals keys
VERIFIED: GET /api/payments/premium-products returns all 4 premium unlock products with correct prices
VERIFIED: Breathwork page shows premium lock overlay on Breathlove sessions for unauthenticated users
VERIFIED: Clicking locked Breathlove session opens unlock modal with section and full app buttons
VERIFIED: Rose Temple page shows premium gate panel with unlock buttons for unauthenticated users
VERIFIED: Healing Portals page shows premium banner and lock indicators on portal cards
VERIFIED: Pricing page has one-time/monthly toggle UI with placeholder note for monthly preview
FIXED: Double dollar sign bug in Rose Temple and Healing Portals Full App buttons (was $$149.00, now $149.00)
